name: Ferry
hint: Ride the ferry as a tower. Jump off the top when it reaches the wall.
why4: The far wall is 4 high and rises straight out of the pit, so climbers need a two-friend tower riding the ferry; the plate on top needs both climbers to let the tower through the tunnel.
solution: When the ferry is docked at the near island (x=12-15), all four step on. P1 stands at its right end; P2 jumps onto P1's head; P3 and P4 stand behind P1 on the ferry.
P3 jumps onto P2's head (1.8 up). When the ferry nears the far end (its right edge at x>=24), P3 jumps right onto the block top (2.2 up).
P4 jumps onto P2's head and jumps onto the block top at the next docking.
P3 and P4 stand on the plate at x=28-29: gate A at the tunnel mouth (x=26) opens.
When the ferry docks again, P2 hops down and P1 and P2 walk off the ferry into the tunnel and out to x=34+. P3 touches the key at x=32; P3 and P4 jump down to the right.
Everyone jumps the 2-wide pit at x=37-38; P3 opens the door at x=42; all press Down.
Recovery: anyone who falls in the pit respawns on the near island and catches the ferry back.
